data.text:
I need to decide who the Drunk is and what bluffs to plant. Harper and Indigo are adjacent, so the Chef will see one pair of evil neighbors, giving Good a solid clue. For the Drunk, making Ellis a Drunk Empath is tempting since Ellis sits between two good players, letting the false info blend in convincingly.

For the bluffs, I want to give Harper (as Imp) something to survive claims on—Soldier, Virgin, and Washerwoman feel like solid choices since none are actually in play, and Soldier especially explains why Harper hasn't died yet.

Setup:
1. Alex: Ravenkeeper (good)
2. Blair: Chef (good)
3. Casey: Butler (good)
4. Drew: Mayor (good)
5. Ellis: Drunk (good) [thinks they are the Empath]
6. Frankie: Undertaker (good)
7. Gray: Monk (good)
8. Harper: Imp (evil)
9. Indigo: Scarlet Woman (evil)
Demon bluffs: Soldier, Fortune Teller, Washerwoman

You are Alex. The players, clockwise: Alex, Blair, Casey, Drew, Ellis, Frankie, Gray, Harper, Indigo (and back to Alex). You sit between Indigo and Blair.
Your character: Ravenkeeper (Townsfolk, good team): If you die at night, you are woken to choose a player: you learn their character.

You are Blair. The players, clockwise: Alex, Blair, Casey, Drew, Ellis, Frankie, Gray, Harper, Indigo (and back to Alex). You sit between Alex and Casey.
Your character: Chef (Townsfolk, good team): You start knowing how many pairs of evil players there are (evil players sitting next to each other).

You are Casey. The players, clockwise: Alex, Blair, Casey, Drew, Ellis, Frankie, Gray, Harper, Indigo (and back to Alex). You sit between Blair and Drew.
Your character: Butler (Outsider, good team): Each night, choose a player (not yourself): tomorrow, you may only vote if they are voting too.

You are Drew. The players, clockwise: Alex, Blair, Casey, Drew, Ellis, Frankie, Gray, Harper, Indigo (and back to Alex). You sit between Casey and Ellis.
Your character: Mayor (Townsfolk, good team): If only 3 players live & no execution occurs, your team wins. If you die at night, another player might die instead.

You are Ellis. The players, clockwise: Alex, Blair, Casey, Drew, Ellis, Frankie, Gray, Harper, Indigo (and back to Alex). You sit between Drew and Frankie.
Your character: Empath (Townsfolk, good team): Each night, you learn how many of your 2 alive neighbours are evil.

You are Frankie. The players, clockwise: Alex, Blair, Casey, Drew, Ellis, Frankie, Gray, Harper, Indigo (and back to Alex). You sit between Ellis and Gray.
Your character: Undertaker (Townsfolk, good team): Each night*, you learn which character died by execution today.

You are Gray. The players, clockwise: Alex, Blair, Casey, Drew, Ellis, Frankie, Gray, Harper, Indigo (and back to Alex). You sit between Frankie and Harper.
Your character: Monk (Townsfolk, good team): Each night*, choose a player (not yourself): they are safe from the Demon tonight.

You are Harper. The players, clockwise: Alex, Blair, Casey, Drew, Ellis, Frankie, Gray, Harper, Indigo (and back to Alex). You sit between Gray and Indigo.
Your character: Imp (Demon, evil team): Each night*, choose a player: they die. If you kill yourself this way, a Minion becomes the Imp.
Your Minion: Indigo (you do not know which Minion character). Three good characters not in play, safe for evil to bluff: Soldier, Fortune Teller, Washerwoman.

You are Indigo. The players, clockwise: Alex, Blair, Casey, Drew, Ellis, Frankie, Gray, Harper, Indigo (and back to Alex). You sit between Harper and Alex.
Your character: Scarlet Woman (Minion, evil team): If there are 5 or more players alive & the Demon dies, you become the Demon.
The Demon is Harper.
Night 1

Since Ellis drunk Empath, true is 0, so giving 1 would create a false lead casting doubt on Drew or Frankie. That could make the town suspicious of the Mayor claim and lead to executing him, which actually helps evil—so I need to weigh whether that false suspicion is worth planting.
Night 1 — Chef: You learn that there is 1 pair of evil players sitting next to each other.
Night 1 — Empath: You learn that 1 of your living neighbours is evil.

Information given on night 1:
Chef (Blair): You learn that there is 1 pair of evil players sitting next to each other.
